::: {.intro}
::: {.intro-body}

[My name is Adam Koplik. I'm a 23-year-old Hamilton College graduate from New
Paltz, New York, currently residing in Manhattan.]{.intro-lead}

I am a research and data analyst with experience spanning infrastructure-focused
geospatial analytics, real estate economics, environmental research, financial
modeling, and marketing analytics — transforming complex spatial and public
datasets into actionable intelligence using Python, R, SQL, Tableau, Excel, and
AI-assisted workflows. I've built convolutional neural networks for satellite
imagery analysis, supported infrastructure development through geospatial
analytics and data integration, and led QA/QC and process improvement
initiatives to enhance data quality and operational efficiency. I'm a strong
researcher and technical communicator with a passion for uncovering complex
information, improving research methodologies, and translating data into
strategic insights.

My résumé is below, along with a contact form. Projects and social feeds live in
the menu above. Thank you for taking the time to learn about me.

:::

### Work Experience

#### TerraPact

**Senior Analyst, Data Intelligence** <small>September 2025 — Present</small>

- Manage strategic infrastructure investment projects using advanced data analytics and geospatial methodologies, overseeing remote vendor teams and leading quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) efforts.
- Developed a convolutional neural network (CNN) using satellite imagery to identify potential infrastructure targets significantly faster than previous methods, while implementing AI-driven workflows that automated external processes and accelerated data cleaning.
- Led the integration of Salesforce and OneDrive data into a centralized remote SQL Server database, directing data migration, cleaning, and analysis to improve data accessibility and operational efficiency.
